name: Seamless Digital
verdict: Seamless Digital (Seamless Digital Ltd, UK) is controlled by Seamless Digital Holdings Limited, whose PSC register names two British individuals, Mark Antony Castro Turner and Robert Rodrigues Decastro Turner (each 25-50%). No state body or fund in the chain. Nothing found.
note: Majesticks GC partner (livgolf.com/majesticks-gc, verified on the team page 2026-10-03); its own site carries a Majesticks GC case study (dynamic displays on the players' golf bags).
